_about: My Book House, Olive Beaupré Miller's graded set of nursery rhymes, fairy tales, legends and classics for children (Chicago: The Bookhouse for Children). The complete first edition (6 volumes, 1920-21; each volume's copyright page reads 1920 or 1921 only) from one scanned run at the Internet Archive, plus the volumes of the enlarged 1928 edition whose scans print no year after 1928. The other 1928 volumes (In the Nursery, Through the Gate, Over the Hills, The Magic Garden, From the Tower Window, In Shining Armor, The Latch Key, Halls of Fame) are online only in 1937-1971 printings, which add copyrighted matter, so they are not taken. Raw Internet Archive OCR, unproofread. Added 2026-10-23 at Adam's ask for old children's sets.
